title: Projective embedding over the source
statement:
With the notation of [lemma-weil-pbc-chow-factorization], the map

$$
 i_X=(\pi,i_Y):\widetilde X\longrightarrow
 X\times_Y\mathbf P^n_Y\simeq\mathbf P^n_X
$$

is a closed immersion over $X$.

proof.text:
The map $i_X$ is an immersion by the graph construction applied to the two
maps supplied by [lemma-weil-pbc-chow-factorization]. Its source is proper over $X$ and its
target is separated over $X$, so $i_X$ is proper; a proper immersion is a
closed immersion.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated morphism, let $a:T\to X$ be a morphism and
let $b:T\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^n_Y$ be a closed immersion with $f\circ a$
equal to $b$ followed by the projection $\mathbf P^n_Y\to Y$. Then the
induced morphism

$$
 (a,b):T\longrightarrow X\times_Y\mathbf P^n_Y\simeq\mathbf P^n_X
$$

is a closed immersion over $X$. In particular, if $f$ is proper, $Y$ is
Noetherian and $\pi:\widetilde X\to X$ with $i_Y:\widetilde X\hookrightarrow
\mathbf P^n_Y$ is its Chow modification [cor-chow-lemma-proper], then the map
$i_X=(\pi,i_Y):\widetilde X\to\mathbf P^n_X$ is a closed immersion over $X$.

proof.text:
The composite of $(a,b)$ with the projection
$X\times_Y\mathbf P^n_Y\to\mathbf P^n_Y$ is the closed immersion $b$. This
projection is the base change of $f$ along $\mathbf P^n_Y\to Y$, hence
separated. If $g\circ h$ is a closed immersion and $g$ is separated, then
$h$ is a closed immersion: $h$ is the graph $T\to T\times_{\mathbf P^n_Y}(X\times_Y\mathbf P^n_Y)$,
a closed immersion as a base change of the diagonal of $g$, followed by the
base change of the closed immersion $g\circ h$. Hence $(a,b)$ is a closed
immersion. For the special case, a proper morphism is separated and
$i_Y$ is a closed immersion with $p\circ i_Y=f\circ\pi$ by
[cor-chow-lemma-proper]; apply
the general statement with $T=\widetilde X$, $a=\pi$ and $b=i_Y$.
